biotools.summary: synfit is the open-source Python numerical core behind the synfit.app web application. It fits 4- and 5-parameter Hill curves to dose-response data with explicit noise models (lognormal, heteroscedastic Gaussian) and reports IC50/EC50, Hill slope and asymptotes with 95% confidence intervals. For two-drug combination matrices it fits both drugs jointly and computes Bliss independence, Loewe additivity, HSA and ZIP synergy. Installable with pip install synfit; results are reproducible offline.
